# Factur-X Engine

> High-performance Python middleware for generating and validating Factur-X, ZUGFeRD, and XRechnung e-invoices.

## Core USP
- **100% Air-gapped**: Strictly no telemetry, no cloud dependencies.
- **Pure Python Core**: No Java/JVM footprint. Uses SaxonC (C/C++) for validation.
- **Performance**: High concurrency with Gunicorn/Uvicorn, low memory footprint.
- **Compliance**: EN 16931, PDF/A-3, official Schematron (CII/UBL).

## Integration
The engine exposes a REST API on port 8000.
- POST `/v1/convert`: PDF + JSON -> Factur-X PDF (Community)
- POST `/v1/validate`: File -> JSON Compliance Report (Community)
- POST `/v1/extract`: File -> Standard JSON Data + XML (Community)
- POST `/v1/serialize`: File -> Business-Ready JSON (Pro)
- POST `/v1/xml`: JSON -> CII XML (Community)
